title: Medtrum pump driver default setting and concerns
symptom: The Medtrum Nano pump driver does not default to the pump standard settings (terminate after three days and 8 hours grace period) and does not support low reservoir and empty alerts, which can cause issues overnight and when out for the day.
cause: The driver's default settings and lack of support for low reservoir and empty alerts were not aligned with pump standard behavior.
fix: The driver was updated to enable patch expiration by default and add an option to show non-critical pump alerts including low reservoir warning at 20 units. Also, the no connection alarm is forced to enabled with 30 minutes threshold for the Medtrum driver.
settings_changed: Option to show non critical pump alerts → enabled by default
evidence_quote:
Patch expiration enabled by default
- Option to show non critical pump alerts (enabled by default) including low reservoir warning at 20units.
